chip.description: Dreamcast/NAOMI sound chip: 64-voice PCM/ADPCM engine and effects DSP with an integrated ARM7DI RISC core that executes the sound program from external RAM.
chip.notes: Taxonomy TB1 (instruction execution absorbs everything on the die) classifies this part as cpu even though its reason for being is sound; MAME models the sound engine (aica) and the embedded ARM7DI (arm7_le) as separate devices of the same package.
